recycler.label: Recycling Works
recycler.description: Sorts and mends the scrap your people throw out. Produces materials every day without touching the ruins, paid for in wealth. The one source of materials that never runs out.

allotments.label: Allotments
allotments.description: Beds, greenhouses and rabbit hutches. Adds 0.4 food a day here, which also grows this district's manpower and population (and a little in your land next door).

watchtower.label: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Lookouts and barricades. Raids, assaults and agitation here are 20% less likely to succeed.

clinic.label: Clinic
clinic.description: Medicine and care. Grievance falls faster and the population grows 50% faster.

market.label: Market
market.description: A place to trade. Earns wealth every day, makes Trade Runs here 20% more likely to succeed, and adds +0.15 wealth/day to each of your trade agreements.

salvage_yard.label: Salvage Yard
salvage_yard.description: Strips the ruins for parts. Produces materials every day, slowly using up the district's ruins.

hostel.label: Hostel
hostel.description: Bunks and hot food. Your manpower limit rises by 4 and this district produces manpower 50% faster.

workshop.label: Workshop
workshop.description: Tools and skilled hands rebuild the district. Development rises every day, raising what the district pays.
